name: ppoll
synopsis: int ppoll(struct pollfd *fds, nfds_t nfds, const struct timespec *_Nullable tmo_p, const sigset_t *_Nullable sigmask);
description: ppoll() waits for one of a set of file descriptors to become ready for I/O operations, similar to poll(), while allowing safe signal handling through a signal mask. It provides a more precise timeout using a timespec structure.

parameters.name: fds
parameters.description: Array of structures specifying the file descriptors to monitor for events

parameters.name: nfds
parameters.description: Number of items in the fds array

parameters.name: tmo_p
parameters.description: Pointer to a timespec structure specifying the timeout, or NULL for indefinite blocking

parameters.name: sigmask
parameters.description: Pointer to a signal set for temporarily modifying the signal mask, or NULL for no change

return_value.success: Returns a nonnegative integer indicating the number of file descriptors that are ready, or zero if the timeout expires
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: fds points outside the process’s accessible address space
A signal occurred before any requested event
The nfds value exceeds the RLIMIT_NOFILE value
The timeout value expressed in *tmo_p is invalid (negative)
Unable to allocate memory for kernel data structures
